rows.notes: The paper explicitly states it is a review ('The aim of this review paper is to give some basic benefits, gains and rules of drip irrigation and fertigation'). It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs; the water-saving and yield figures in Table 1 are taken from Shah (2011) and the 30-70% water saving claims are cited from Postel et al. (2001), Cetin and Bilgel (2002) and Chartzoulakis and Bertaki (2015). Statements that drip delivers water directly to the root zone with less evaporation and no runoff are narrative assertions, not results of this study. Q1 is 'no', so all other questions are 'no'.
